Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Mall

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Cyber-grunts in the field can’t delay their assault by thinking too long. So, Militech speeds up their thinking via neural overclocking.

Chipware. While installed in a Chipware Socket, when the user Takes Extra Time on any non-Downtime task needing mental focus or clarity (e.g., Lock Picking, Long-range Recon, Tactics Checks, etc), they may activate this Chipware without an Action to only require half as long to gain the bonus from doing so (twice as long instead of four times longer) and to increase the provided bonus by 1 (+2 Total). Has a 60 second (20 Rounds) cooldown before it can be activated again.

NOTE: This is very vaguely based on a specific shard in Cyberpunk 2077 which mentions it.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Goes in a Chipware Socket: install the socket first, then install this into it.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
